sources.title: Liberia Immigration Service: Visa on Arrival workflow
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Visa on Arrival service is hosted on the Liberia Immigration Service lis.gov.lr subdomain and identifies LIS as the authority enforcing the Alien and Nationality Law.
sources.supportingExcerpt: At the airport ... biometric data collection ... you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.

sources.title: Liberia Immigration Service: 2025 Service Delivery Charter
sources.officialityEvidence: LIS publishes its January 2025 Service Delivery Charter on lis.gov.lr. It defines Visa on Arrival as a service for non-African and non-ECOWAS African citizens who meet unstated eligibility criteria.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Processing of VISA ON ARRIVAL (Non-African and Non ECOWAS African Citizens).

sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of Liberia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Liberian Senate currently hosts the Constitution PDF. Article 13(b) grants every Liberian citizen the right to enter Liberia at any time.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Every Liberian Citizen shall have the right to leave and to enter Liberia at any time.

policies.title: Liberian ordinary passport: citizenship entry
policies.summary: The Constitution gives every Liberian citizen the right to enter Liberia at any time.
conditions: Applies only to a traveller whose ordinary passport establishes Liberian citizenship. It is a citizenship classification, not a visa waiver for foreign nationals or special documents. Border inspection and admission controls remain separate.

unresolved.reason: Current LIS sources establish a conditional Visa on Arrival process, not an eVisa: online approval is followed by biometric collection and visa-sticker issuance at Roberts International Airport. The route depends on an applicant’s country of residence/available Liberian embassy and on unstated eligibility criteria; no current official nationality or ordinary-passport schedule maps this passport. Do not infer visa-on-arrival, electronic issuance or an advance-mission complement.
